_comment: Golden response for BAAI/bge-m3-multi. The field names, nesting, and types
below were verified against a live response on 2026-08-01; the values are
synthetic, so this file carries no account identifiers and no real
document text.
Verified live shape, for one input:
embeddings  [input][1024] floats
sparse      [input][250002] floats — the FULL vocabulary row, mostly
zeros, not a coordinate map. Its length is what reveals the
vocabulary size, which is why WithSparseVocabulary is not
needed against this model.
colbert     [input][token][1024] floats
input_tokens, request_id, inference_status{status, tokens_input, ...}
The live response also carries embedding_jsons: the dense vectors a second
time as JSON strings. It is ignored, and it is why a dense response is
39 KB per input rather than 20 KB.
Sizes measured the same day, per input: dense 39 KB, sparse 977 KB,
colbert ~34 KB per token, all three 1185 KB. See defaultBatchSize.
Vectors here are truncated to 4 dimensions and the sparse rows to an
8-token vocabulary so the fixture stays readable.
Inputs: ["sparse vectors", "dense vectors"]
